def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Compact square-law equation with Ambach-Lehnert refinement."""
    (KP, theta, Vt, L) = parameters[:4]
    
    sub_theta = np.exp((gate_voltage_abs - theta) / Vt)
    ID = (KP * (sub_theta * (drain_voltage_abs - Vt))**2) / (1 + sub_theta)
    
    logID = np.log10(np.abs(ID / 1.0))
    
    # Ambach-Lehnert refinement
    alpha = parameters[4]
    beta = parameters[5]
    gamma = parameters[6]
    delta = parameters[7]
    eta = parameters[8]
    zeta = parameters[9]
    Uthrp = parameters[10]
    Uthrn = parameters[11]
    
    logID += alpha * (pow((drain_voltage_abs - drain_voltage_abs.mean()), beta) - pow((drain_voltage_abs - drain_voltage_abs.min()), beta))
    logID += gamma * (np.exp(delta * gate_voltage_abs) - np.exp(delta * (gate_voltage_abs - eta)) - delta * eta * np.exp(delta * (gate_voltage_abs - eta)))
